description: Lightweight SDR receiver with spectrum, waterfall and audio demodulation for small-screen Linux devices.

store.summary: Real-time SDR spectrum, waterfall and audio for RTL-SDR
store.description: zeroSDR is a lightweight Software Defined Radio receiver for small-screen Linux devices. It renders the spectrum and waterfall directly into the framebuffer and demodulates FM, NFM, AM, USB and LSB audio through ALSA, with squelch, audio AGC, FM de-emphasis and display zoom. An on-screen help/settings overlay is available with the H key. It also includes an ADSB aircraft page driven by readsb.

zh-CN.summary: RTL-SDR 实时频谱、瀑布与解调收听
zh-CN.description: zeroSDR 是面向小屏幕 Linux 设备的轻量 SDR 接收程序：频谱和瀑布直接渲染到 framebuffer，FM/NFM/AM/USB/LSB 解调通过 ALSA 输出，支持静噪、音频 AGC、FM 去加重和显示缩放；按 H 打开屏幕帮助与设置；另含基于 readsb 的 ADSB 飞机页面。
